'''Dexen Eronoss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was working as an shift foreman for [[Nova Orion Industries]] on the [[Nova Orion Station]].
